description: "A Changed Heart" by May Agnes Fleming is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story unfolds in the foggy coastal town of Speckport, introducing readers to a society filled with various characters, including the ambitious Miss Jeannette McGregor, who hosts a bustling soirée.
